ns2:section.sectionText: Center for Innovation in Teaching & Learning (CITL) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.citl.illinois.edu. The last synchronous section will meet on July 31. Online scheduled class sessions require that each student have high speed internet access and either a headset with microphone or an external microphone and speakers so they may participate in the class discussions. This section has one or more proctored exams, which may carry additional fees. Proctoring options include fee-based ProctorU and approved proctoring centers. For ProctorU technical specifications and additional information visit: http://www.ao.uiuc.edu/support/source/student_services/proctoru_tech.html. Priority registration will be given to FSHN MS Online degree seeking students through May 1, 2014. Pending seating availability, non-degree seeking students may enroll after May 1. To be added to the course wait-list, email a request to annamehl@illinois.edu. Recommended Text: Fermented Beverage Production, by Lea, Andrew G.H.; Piggott, John R. (Eds.) 2nd ed., 2003, 462 p., Softcover, ISBN 978-0-306-47706-5
